sam3.version_status: No package version or release tag pinned by TSegAgent; exact source commit is pinned as the submodule gitlink.

runtime_requirements_from_pinned_readme.pytorch: >=2.7; pinned SAM3 README example uses torch==2.7.0 with cu126
runtime_requirements_from_pinned_readme.torchvision: not separately pinned by SAM3 README; TSegAgent pins 0.24.1+cu130

sam3.weights_access: manual gated access; Hugging Face requires access approval and authentication
sam3.weight_filename_for_default_builder: sam3.pt (inferred from SAM3 repository model metadata/default builder; not downloaded)
sam3.weight_terms: Covered by SAM License after access/acceptance; license grants non-exclusive worldwide non-transferable royalty-free rights, requires redistribution under the same agreement, and provides no warranty. Commercial suitability is not assumed; legal review remains required.

dependencies.cuda: >=12.6 according to TSegAgent README; TSegAgent wheel pins are cu130
dependencies.opengl: OpenGL development libraries plus EGL for offscreen rasterization; exact system package versions not pinned

rasterizer.name: reversible_rasterizer
rasterizer.build: CMake >=3.27, C++17, pybind11 2.13.6 fetched by CMake, Eigen 3.4.0 fetched by CMake, Assimp vendored, OpenGL EGL

pipeline.input: trimesh.load(model_path, process=False); documented examples are Teeth3DS-style OBJ files in separate upper/lower case directories
pipeline.stl_support: not documented or verified; canonical STL conversion was not performed
preprocessing: MeshRenderer normalizes by bounding-box centroid and scale
map SAM3 image masks through reversible rasterizer face ID maps
merge, remove disconnected parts, fill small gaps, reorder face instance IDs
pipeline.coordinate_convention: MeshRenderer applies translation by bounding-box centroid and scale by max radial distance; rotations are Euler degree triples and camera is orthographic. No dental upper/lower axis convention is documented beyond Teeth3DS filename context.
pipeline.upper_lower: Teeth3DS directory and *_upper.obj / *_lower.obj naming; Predictor itself accepts a single model path and does not validate jaw from geometry. FDI VLM prompt separately asks for jaw upper/lower.
required_checkpoints: SAM3 gated foundation checkpoint; TSegAgent publishes no own checkpoint
pipeline.segmentation_without_vlm: YES: Predictor(use_gpt=False) and test_teeth3ds.py --disable-gpt run the SAM3 segmentation/postprocessing path without creating an OpenAI/ARK client.
pipeline.fdi_without_vlm: NO: FDI classification is implemented by predict_fdi_from_images using the external VLM; --disable-gpt intentionally omits it.

internal.face_labels: positive integer instance IDs after multi-view merge/postprocessing; 0 unlabeled/background
internal.face_id: pre-FDI face instance labels retained only when VLM is used
internal.gpt_output: raw/processed VLM JSON only when VLM is used

output.json_export: {labels: vertex_labels[], debug_info: ..., face_id: [], gpt_output: null} without VLM; with VLM includes face_id and gpt_output
output.vertex_labels: majority vote of incident positive face labels; unlabeled vertices remain 0
output.instance_representation: face-level integer regions from SAM3 masks projected through face ID maps; vertex labels are derived by incident-face majority, not independent instance segmentation
output.confidence: SAM3 scores are captured internally per view but are not exported into the JSON or aggregated into per-instance confidence
output.fdi: external VLM JSON with id/fdi/type/bad_id and jaw, then fdi_optimize remaps face labels; unavailable in no-VLM mode

reversible_rasterizer.behavior: Orthographic renderer returns a pixel-to-face ID map; IDs identify original face indices in the renderer mesh. TSegAgent maps each positive SAM3 pixel mask to unique face IDs.
reversible_rasterizer.normalization_effect: renderer mutates the loaded trimesh by translating/scaling vertices; indices/faces remain aligned but coordinates are normalized, not original clinical coordinates
reversible_rasterizer.coverage: face_coverage debug ratio records whether faces were seen across fixed views; uncovered faces remain unlabeled
reversible_rasterizer.outlier_and_gap_processing: removes small disconnected same-label components and fills small unlabeled face gaps by adjacency majority; these are deterministic research heuristics, not validated clinical postprocessing

tooth_instance_mapping.id: AVAILABLE as research face/vertex region IDs, but IDs are reordered by arch geometry and are not stable FDI IDs
tooth_instance_mapping.fdi: AVAILABLE only with external VLM; NOT AVAILABLE in no-VLM segmentation-only mode
tooth_instance_mapping.jaw: DERIVABLE from input naming/context; not emitted as a stable segmentation field in no-VLM JSON
tooth_instance_mapping.mesh: DERIVABLE from original face topology and face labels, but exported vertices are normalized and unlabeled/uncovered faces require explicit handling
tooth_instance_mapping.confidence: CANNOT BE SAFELY DERIVED as per-tooth confidence

rights.sam3_code_and_weights: SAM License; gated weights require acceptance/authentication; terms include redistribution conditions and no warranty
rights.vlm_api_terms: OpenAI and ARK/Doubao service terms apply; no API key was used and no paid call was made
rights.dataset: README points to Teeth3DS via OSF; applicable dataset/training-data terms were not re-licensed by TSegAgent. The related 3DTeethSeg challenge repository identifies its data as CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, so commercial clearance is not assumed.
rights.checkpoint_terms: No TSegAgent checkpoint terms because TSegAgent has no own checkpoint; SAM3 checkpoint access/terms remain gated and separate.

hardware.cloud_gpu_minimum: Official software minimum is CUDA >=12.6 and no VRAM minimum is published by TSegAgent/SAM3 README.
hardware.cloud_gpu_recommendation: Modern NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12.6+; 24 GB VRAM is a planning target but sufficiency is UNKNOWN until gated SAM3 weights and the exact pinned build are tested.
hardware.disk_estimate: Exact SAM3 weight size is unavailable from the gated Hugging Face metadata. Reserve at least 30 GB free for environment, build trees, caches, model files, and rendered intermediates; this is a planning reserve, not a measured requirement.
hardware.rtx40_compatibility: No TSegAgent-specific RTX40/RTX50 compatibility statement found. SAM3 requires CUDA 12.6+; compatibility is UNKNOWN.
hardware.cloud_feasibility: UNKNOWN until SAM3 access is approved and a 24 GB-class environment is tested; technically plausible, not reproducibly ready now.

SAM3_WEIGHTS_STATUS: NOT_PUBLICLY_OBTAINABLE_WITHOUT_MANUAL_ACCESS_APPROVAL; filename/size/hash not available without authenticated access
INPUT_COMPATIBILITY: PARTIAL; documented Teeth3DS OBJ layout, raw canonical STL not verified
ORIGINAL_MESH_MAPPING: PARTIAL; face indices are preserved through rasterizer and vertex labels are majority-derived, but normalized coordinates and uncovered/mixed faces require benchmark validation
